commands.name: map-rows-cover-installer
commands.run: out=$(HOME=/nonexistent-symlink-audit-home /bin/bash .claude/skills/dotfiles-diagnostics-and-tooling/scripts/symlink-audit.sh --list-expected) && for p in bin/remote-access-doctor bin/zed-claude-agent bin/herdr-zed-attach .codex/hooks/herdr_worktree_guard.py .codex/hooks/rm_guard.py .codex/hooks/herdr_stop_gate.py .codex/hooks/orch_edit_guard.py .codex/hooks/git_remote_guard.py .codex/skills/writing-plans .codex/skills/review-change .codex/rules/agent-lessons.md; do printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "^link	/nonexistent-symlink-audit-home/$p	" || { echo "missing row: $p"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: contract-orphan-probe
commands.run: R=$(pwd -P); T=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sa-contract.XXXXXX") || exit 1; mkdir -p "$T/home/bin" && ln -s "$R/bin/retired-tool-for-contract" "$T/home/bin/retired" && ln -s "$R-sibling/bin/tool" "$T/home/bin/sibling" && ln -s /nonexistent-elsewhere/tool "$T/home/bin/foreign"; HOME="$T/home" /bin/bash .claude/skills/dotfiles-diagnostics-and-tooling/scripts/symlink-audit.sh > "$T/out" 2>&1; audit_rc=$?; rc=0; [ "$audit_rc" -eq 1 ] || rc=1; grep -qxF "[X]  ORPHAN-DANGLING $T/home/bin/retired -> $R/bin/retired-tool-for-contract (missing inside checkout $R)" "$T/out" || rc=1; grep -qF -- "$T/home/bin/sibling" "$T/out" && rc=1; grep -qF -- "$T/home/bin/foreign" "$T/out" && rc=1; grep -qE -- ' 1 orphan link\(s\), 0 scan error\(s\)\.$' "$T/out" || rc=1; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || cat "$T/out"; rm -rf "$T"; exit "$rc"

commands.name: docs-document-orphans
commands.run: f=.claude/skills/dotfiles-diagnostics-and-tooling/SKILL.md; for w in ORPHAN-DANGLING ORPHAN-LIVE UNOWNED-LIVE INCOMPLETE --root --list-expected 'orphan link(s), <I> scan error(s).'; do grep -qF -- "$w" "$f" || { echo "undocumented: $w"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: changed-files-ascii
commands.run: python3 -c 'import sys; [open(p, "rb").read().decode("ascii") for p in sys.argv[1:]]' .claude/skills/dotfiles-diagnostics-and-tooling/scripts/symlink-audit.sh .claude/skills/dotfiles-diagnostics-and-tooling/scripts/symlink-audit.test.sh .claude/skills/dotfiles-diagnostics-and-tooling/SKILL.md bin/dotfiles-tests

commands.name: installer-suites-unchanged
commands.run: sh install/install.test.sh && sh install/ai-update.test.sh && sh install/claude-links.test.sh
